question.text: The least value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi><mo> </mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>, such that the function <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">∫</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></math> satisfies <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></math>, is (given, <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>)

solution.text:
Given function is f n,x =n⋅ sin nx n +c
As fn,0=0⇒c=0
∴fn,x=sin⁡nx
If fn,π2=-1 , we have sin⁡nπ2=-1
⇒n=3,7,11,……
∴nmin=3
